messages:
morgan: Quick check-in re: PM-2026 action items (alert noise + paging policy). Posting a compact status thread so we can close out owners and dates. Who has changes queued?

samir: I have the 'db-read-latency' alert on my plate. Current behavior: pages on 5 occurrences in 10m at 500ms. I'm proposing: 1) bump to 2s 95th, 2) reduce sensitivity to 3/15m, 3) add dedupe by service+shard.

elaine: FYI I updated the runbook link in the postmortem: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/pm-2026. Added a short mitigation step for noisy read replicas.
\nops-bot: Pager summary for last week: db-read-latency fired 23 times across 4 services, 14 resulted in pages. Top 2 signal sources: replica lag spikes, synthetic warmup jobs.

jordan: +1 to Samir's thresholds. Also propose we route alerts with severity=low to a digest channel instead of paging during 00:00-06:00 UTC unless error-rate>5%. That'd cover synthetic warmups.

lee: I can implement the dedupe key (trace_id + shard) and the digest routing. Plan: PR for config changes by EOD Thu, deploy Fri. Owner: lee.

samir: I'll open the alert change PR tonight. Target: merge Thu, rollout canary Fri morning. I'll add a toggle so we can revert quickly.

morgan: Great. Let's record owners + ETA here so we can mark them complete in the postmortem action list:
- Action: Update db-read-latency thresholds and add dedupe -> owner: samir + lee, ETA: 2025-01-16
- Action: Route low-sev noise to digest window -> owner: jordan, ETA: 2025-01-18
- Action: Add runbook note about synthetic jobs & checklists -> owner: elaine, ETA: 2025-01-15

jordan: For the digest, I'll add a small metric: "digest_suppression_window" label so we can measure alerts suppressed vs fired. Will also add a small dashboard to track suppressed_count.

elaine: Can someone add the expected rollback plan to the PR description? If we change thresholds and it causes missed incidents, we need an immediate fallback (revert toggle + page if error rate spikes).

samir: I'll include the revert toggle + rollback steps in the PR. Also adding a canary tag to only affect 20% of traffic for 24h.

morgan: One more ask: let's capture recurring incident fingerprints before we change rules so we can compare after tuning. Could someone export the last 90 days of alerts for db-read-latency (include attributes: host, shard, synthetic_tag)?

lee: On it. I'll dump csv and attach to the postmortem doc by tomorrow.

ops-bot: Note: Oncall rotation reminder: @lee is primary this week, @samir secondary. If we push changes during Friday rollout, please coordinate handover.

morgan: Thanks team. If PRs/links get posted here I'll tick them off and update the action item table. Trying to avoid a repeat of the midnight pages pattern — want clear owners + measurable rollback.

samir: PR: https://git.redwood/repo/alerts/pulls/4123 (WIP). Added code snippet in PR: ```yaml\nalert: db-read-latency\nthreshold: 2000ms\noccurrences: 3/15m\ndedupe_by: [service, shard]\nlabels:\n  severity: high-if-error-rate>5%\n  digest_window: 00:00-06:00\n```

morgan: Perfect. I'll update the postmortem actions and check back on Monday for status. If anything slips, ping here with reason + new ETA. :thumbsup:
